about: The epistola of the formulary “Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The Lord possessed me in the beginning of His ways, before He made anything, from the beginning. From eternity I was established, and from ancient times, before the earth was made. The depths did not yet exist, and I had already been conceived. Now therefore, children, hear me: Blessed are they who keep my ways. Hear instruction and be wise, and do not cast it away. Blessed is the man who hears me, and who keeps vigil at my doors every day, and watches at the posts of my door. Whoever finds me will find life and will draw salvation from the Lord.
